text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday delivered a magnificent 
run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The radiance overflowing from her seemed 
to reach even her rivals out on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The miracle knows no bounds. She takes her 
next steps toward her new goal: the Japan 
Cup—
